answer: Give each identity a standing that loses a fixed delta every epoch, like sand running off a dune, and let only attestations from peers outside its own kin group restore it. An operator's farm is one vine: every clone is a tendril off the same root, so clones vouching for each other restore nothing. Each new clone needs an outsider who has not yet vouched this epoch, and every such vouch spends that outsider's own decaying standing. A thousand-clone farm must buy a thousand independent established identities, burning exactly the credit an honest newcomer needed.
